_comment: Copy this to the RELEASE repo (Aquaman-TSH/aquasentinel-releases) as ai-models.json. The app fetches it at launch and overrides ONLY the model ids below — no base URLs or keys. When a provider deprecates a model, edit the id here and every user is fixed on next launch (no app release). Unknown keys/fields are ignored. If the file is missing or unreachable, the app uses its built-in defaults. Keep these in sync with src/services/aiProvider.js when you cut a release.
